highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 with GPU-backed GTK4 views and restored Linux system-font discovery.
highlights_body: This preview also aligns WebAssembly native assets with .NET 11 and moves Tizen packages to Tizen 10. GTK4 applications gain explicit control over physical-pixel and logical-coordinate painting.

breaking.title: Choose GTK4 painting coordinates explicitly
breaking.body: SKDrawingArea now defaults to physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info on high-density displays. Set IgnorePixelScaling to true to retain logical painting coordinates while preserving full-resolution backing pixels. RawInfo remains physical, and GTK input coordinates remain logical.

breaking.title: Move Tizen applications to Tizen 10
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp Tizen native packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and require Tizen 10 on x64 or arm64; Tizen 8/9 and 32-bit native builds are no longer supported. Update application targets and deployment requirements. Building the native libraries requires the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2 toolchain.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 156 without adding managed APIs or native entry points. HarfBuzzSharp's 14.4.0.100 package revision accompanies the milestone; the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0.

SKGLArea adds PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext and an opt-in render loop using GTK's GL context. QueueRender requests a repaint. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy, GTK's GL dispatcher.

The default font manager discovers installed fonts without fontconfig again, using /usr/share/fonts/ unless overridden at native build time. This restores family lookup and prevents SKShaper construction failures caused by empty typefaces when fonts are installed.
The raster view releases its Skia surface before Cairo's backing pixel storage and marks pixels dirty after channel swizzling.
SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now select Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for net11 and later, including threading and SIMD variants. net8 retains 3.1.34; net9 and net10 retain 3.1.56.

Windows native builds use matching v143 Spectre CRT libraries, and ANGLE propagates control-flow guard and stack-cookie flags to eligible third-party code. Spectre CRT provenance does not imply whole-program Spectre mitigation.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored directory-backed system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies packages.

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 introduces Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and physical-pixel scaling, and restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery. It also aligns .NET 11 WebAssembly assets and moves Tizen packages to Tizen 10.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp aligns WebAssembly archive selection with .NET 11, moves Tizen native packages to Tizen 10, and uses matching v143 Spectre CRT libraries in Windows native builds. These changes do not upgrade the native HarfBuzz engine.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: Preview 1 introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and physical-pixel scaling, restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, and aligned .NET 11 WebAssembly assets and Tizen 10 packages.
